subject: do-16 image defects: no git identity (E2) + master-vs-main corrupts s3/s4 (E3)
description: Found by SBX-7 badge authoring agent 2026-07-10 (verified against images/terminal-full/entrypoint.sh + lab HTML): (E2) entrypoint sets git identity ONLY repo-local to ~/lab; scenario repos ~/git-lab-s1..s6 have no identity -> every commit fails 'Author identity unknown'; lab text never mentions it. (E3) ubuntu:24.04 git 2.43 defaults to master; lab setup scripts run 'git checkout main' -> s3 fast-forwards (no conflict), s4 merges branch into itself. Fix: entrypoint adds git config --global user.email/user.name + init.defaultBranch main for student. bc1 image rebuild via bc1-cf. PRECONDITION for do-16 badge checks s3/s4. Also minor E4: s1 setup echo writes literal \n (harmless).
